description: This file defines the SugarCache class, which manages different cache backends such as memory caches and opcode caches, providing mechanisms to initialize, retrieve instances, clean cache, reset caches, and interface with external cache systems in a SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SugarCache
classes.description: A class responsible for managing cache backends, including initialization, cleanup, and cache reset functionalities used within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the appropriate cache backend, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the cache backend by locating and instantiating the suitable cache class from specified directories.

methods.name: cleanOpcodes
methods.description: Attempts to clear various opcode caches like APC, Zend, eAccelerator, and XCache, optionally resetting the full cache.

methods.name: cleanFile
methods.description: Invalidates the opcode cache for a specific file.

methods.name: cleanDir
methods.description: Removes cache entries for all PHP files within a directory.

methods.name: isOPcacheEnabled
methods.description: Checks if PHP's Zend OPcache is enabled.
